The '''Melantha Embassy''' on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], was located on [[Estalle Island]]. It was large, ornate, and colored green. The reason why the embassy was painted green was long forgotten, but tradition dictated it remain that way. It was rumored that [[House Melantha]] kept a tourture chamber in the embassy's basement.
